findings.title: Local reviewed_at optionality collapses a required frozen projection distinction
findings.evidence: R2.md:190-196 says reviewed_at is absent/null or an ISO date. The pinned validator obtains it with record.get at vendor/claude-obsidian/claude_obsidian/ledgers.py:1030, accepts omitted or null for non-accepted claims, requires a non-null ISO date only for assessment accepted at :1031-1039, and rejects future dates at :1040-1045. The frozen local projection contract instead says reviewed_at is a required key that may be null and that missing never becomes null (docs/ai/contracts/projection-input-v1.md:154-156). Current _ledgers uses item.get without a presence bit at catalog_collector.py:79-80.
findings.required_fix: State the two layers separately. Pinned/upstream validation may accept an omitted or null reviewed_at for non-accepted claims, validates an ISO date when present, and requires a non-null date for accepted claims. The local closed projection must either preserve missing-versus-null with a reviewed_at presence flag or explicitly supersede that frozen projection rule; it must not claim exact closure while _ledgers silently collapses both to the same row.
findings.acceptance: A non-accepted pinned-valid claim with omitted reviewed_at is handled only at the upstream layer. A local projected row preserves the omission or rejects it by the named closure rule; explicit null remains distinct. Accepted claims with omitted/null reviewed_at fail pinned validation; accepted claims with a non-future ISO date pass this field rule.

findings.title: Pinned evidence permits absent/null locator, while local decoding requires the closed wire
findings.evidence: The pinned validator checks locator only when present at vendor/claude-obsidian/claude_obsidian/ledgers.py:1089-1093; it does not require the key. Local decode_ledger_evidence requires exactly source_id, relation, and locator at src/video_paper_wiki/ledger_locator.py:203-215, and _ledgers accesses evidence["locator"] directly at catalog_collector.py:81-83. R2.md:204 says to decode the accepted v1/v2 union without specifying this upstream/local distinction.
findings.required_fix: Declare the boundary: the pinned adapter may accept absent/null locator according to its current validator, while the local closed projection requires the exact wire needed by decode_ledger_evidence and rejects or explicitly classifies any pinned-valid item that cannot be represented. Never invent a locator or let a missing locator reach the direct collector indexing path.
findings.acceptance: A pinned-valid evidence object with a missing/null locator produces the stable local-closure refusal before row emission, without a KeyError. A canonical tagged locator with source_id, relation, and locator decodes, preserves supports|contradicts|context, and retains order and duplicates.

findings.title: R2 still omits source enum domains and the evidence relation domain from its exact field clause
findings.evidence: R2.md:190-196 lists claim risk/assessment/confidence but does not list source origin/content/authority/status values or evidence relations. The pinned constants are at vendor/claude-obsidian/claude_obsidian/ledgers.py:25-49 and enforcement is at :514-582, :955-963, and :1073-1074.
findings.required_fix: Add the exact domains: origin.kind = file|url|manual; source content_kind = document|webpage|dataset|image|audio|video|code|conversation|synthetic|other; source authority = official|primary|secondary|community|synthetic|unknown; source review_status = unreviewed|active|superseded|rejected; claim risk = normal|high; assessment = accepted|provisional|contested|unsupported|deprecated; confidence = high|medium|low|unknown; evidence relation = supports|contradicts|context. Keep synthetic-content/authority pairing and accepted/high-risk/contested evidence checks separate from enum membership.
findings.acceptance: Every listed value is accepted in its field and every unlisted spelling is rejected in both the pinned/local contract resources. The relation transport keeps context as the wire relation and does not rewrite it to supports.

findings.title: Paper anchor ^claim-id is a new local restriction and is not a pinned claim-field rule
findings.evidence: R2.md:197-203 requires a paper anchor of ^<claim-id>, while the pinned validator only checks that a non-null anchor is scalar text and, when a page is available, matches either an existing heading or an existing block ID at vendor/claude-obsidian/claude_obsidian/ledgers.py:981-1028. The frozen projection contract describes anchor as optional-nullable at docs/ai/contracts/projection-input-v1.md:154-156; current _ledgers preserves the raw anchor at catalog_collector.py:79-80.
findings.required_fix: If ^<claim-id> is an intentional paper-only local profile rule, label it as a prospective owner/page invariant rather than a pinned claim-ledger field and provide its exact migration/legacy exception. Otherwise remove it and retain the pinned heading-or-block anchor check. Do not impose this spelling on repository claims, whose v1 renderer has no claim block anchors as R2 already notes.
findings.acceptance: A legacy paper claim with a valid heading anchor or null anchor follows its declared profile; a paper ^claim-id rule is enforced only where explicitly versioned and rendered. Repository claims retain their existing optional/null/text anchor semantics. Pinned validation remains independent of the local owner policy.

findings.title: Source identity must retain the pinned formula and broader historical safe-ID boundary
findings.evidence: The pinned validator accepts source-map keys through _safe_ledger_id(source_id, "src-") at vendor/claude-obsidian/claude_obsidian/ledgers.py:501-504 and checks the stable formula at :607-624. stable_source_id is computed only from origin_kind, canonicalized locator, and optional content_sha256 at :407-414, not from an entire source row. The accepted historical registration projection uses src-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* at source_registration.py:21 and :86-90, and catalog_collector.py:71-77 preserves map keys verbatim.
findings.required_fix: Keep this profile distinction explicit. Do not impose src-<20hex> on all legacy/historical IDs and do not describe source identity as a digest of the complete row. For full pinned validation, compare a source key with stable_source_id(origin.kind, origin.locator, content_sha256) where that validator applies; for historical projection, retain its broader safe src- grammar. Claim evidence requires resolution in the complete source map under the applicable profile.
findings.acceptance: A historical-safe ID such as src-paper is not rejected merely for lacking a 20-hex suffix; a pinned row with a wrong stable formula is rejected; changing formula inputs is an identity conflict rather than a new unrelated row.
